data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for Digio KYC, eSign, UPI, mandate, and video verification flows.
data.what_it_does: Allows your Flutter application to trigger and run Digio's complete KYC workflows, electronic signatures, UPI, mandate, and reverse penny drop flows on Android and iOS. It also supports a stateless selfie capture mode using JWT credentials.
use_when: You need to integrate Digio KYC and eSign workflows into your app
You require native document capture, video KYC, and biometric authentication flows
avoid_when: You are building a non-fintech application that does not require identity verification
You want a custom UI built entirely in Flutter for your onboarding process
strengths: Supports a wide range of regulated workflows like eSign, UPI, and mandates
Provides both full workflow orchestration and stateless native task modes
weaknesses: Requires extensive native configuration and repository setups on Android
Depends on proprietary third-party native SDKs
data.setup_notes: Requires adding custom Maven repositories, configuring Android build.gradle, updating ProGuard rules or using BOM settings, and adding camera, microphone, and location permissions for Android and iOS.
